scope: Curated primary-source entry points, not an exhaustive model catalog or live availability guarantee. External pages are not frozen evidence.

project_role_definitions.tested_checkpoint: This exact checkpoint family/size was evaluated; consult the frozen run for revision and task.
project_role_definitions.used_benchmark: Used in recorded experiments, with the project's mappings and subsets.
project_role_definitions.demo_dataset: Used in the original interactive demo, not a labelled main-study benchmark.
project_role_definitions.provider_guidance: Recommendations or examples from the provider; not measured findings of this project.
project_role_definitions.background_paper: Original research for a model or dataset; distinguish its version and results from ours.
project_role_definitions.discovery_only: Search entry point outside our evaluated panel; no comparative result is implied.
